16:80.text: And Allāh has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment

16:81.text: And Allāh has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows
and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments
battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit

16:83.text: They recognize the favor of Allāh; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.

16:84.text: the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness
. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers
, nor will they be asked to appease

16:85.text: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.

16:86.text: And when those who associated others with Allāh see their "partners," they will say, "Our Lord, these are our partners
besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."

16:87.text: And they will impart to Allāh that Day
submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
